releaseNotes:
﻿## Guest Inbox
- Two-pane thread workspace with booking link, availability, and reply stages
- Availability-aware reply snippets and clearer compose flow

## Bookings & Conferences
- Separate conference arrival/departure stay from meeting days
- Calendar uses normal colors on stay-only days; meeting days stay conference-colored
- Day-guest counts on conference rows show as "N day"
- Conference fee (Value of Service) charged only on meeting days

## Settings
- Custom airlines under Settings → Airlines
- Removing a mailbox clears connection fields to blank (no default hosts)

## Fixes
- Safer database migration when adding conference date columns during build
